title: Building SafeBite: Local Gemma 2 Allergy Guard for a Friend in 1 Hour

content.text: I want to enter the Hacktoberfest Weekend Challenge: 'Build for a Friend' with open-source AI at its core. I haven't downloaded Gemma yet and want to build something in under an hour for my roommate Alex who has severe Celiac disease, peanut allergies, and lactose intolerance.
Let's install Ollama, pull Google DeepMind's Gemma 2 (2B open weights), and build SafeBite—a 100% private, offline meal planner and ingredient scanner.

content.name: ollama_pull_gemma
content.output: Successfully downloaded and verified gemma2:2b (1.6 GB)

content.text: Now let's build the full-stack application and test local inference.
I've created server.js, public/index.html, style.css, and app.js. Let's test the allergen scanner against sneaky ingredients and generate a safe pantry recipe.

content.name: test_allergen_scanner
content.input: POST /api/scan-ingredients (Ingredients: dehydrated potatoes, vegetable oil, soy sauce powder, hydrolyzed whey protein)
content.output:
**SAFETY VERDICT**: [UNSAFE / DANGER]

FLAGGED INGREDIENTS:
- Hydrolyzed whey protein: Contains dairy (lactose).
- Soy sauce powder (wheat, soybeans): Contains wheat/gluten.

ACTIONABLE VERDICT FOR ROOMMATE: Do not prepare this meal for Alex.

content.name: test_recipe_generator
content.input: POST /api/generate-recipe (Pantry: chicken breast, jasmine rice, broccoli, olive oil, garlic, ginger, honey)
content.output: Sweet & Spicy Ginger Chicken Bowls. Allergen-Safe Guarantee: 100% gluten-free, dairy-free, and peanut-free. Includes cross-contamination kitchen hygiene tips.

content.text: Configured git remote to https://github.com/adibafna/safebite-gemma.git and pushed branch main to GitHub successfully!
